usedFor: Shopify holds your catalog and AnnounceKit publishes updates, so “New Product” can start a “Create Post”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product” in Shopify, then “Create Post” in AnnounceKit
bestTemplate.why: Each new product can become a changelog post with a title, content and publishing schedule.

watchOut: “Create Post” sets visibility and audience targeting, so check both before a product post goes public.
